title: Mere Malik Mujhe'n Lafzo'n Ka Khazana Dede
body:
Mere Malik mujhe Lafzo'n ka Khazana De De...
Naghma Bulbul Ka De Qumri Ka Tarana De De...
Madha Haider Ki Likhu'n Khol Ke Dil Apna Ameer...
Qaem E Aale Mohd Ka Zamana De De...
Ishq E Shabbir Me Wo Log Jo Mar Jate Hain...
Yu'n Samajh Lijye Pardes Se Ghar Jaate Hain...
Hum To Parwane Hain Sholo'n Se Guzar Jaate Hain...
Aur Kuch Log To Jugnu Se Bhi Darr Jate Hain...
Mushkile'n Gher Le'n Aakar To Lo Abbas Ka Naam...
Naam E Abbas Se Tufaan Thahar Jaate Hain...
